verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ALERUUYA! mumwebaze
Yesu,Mukama waffe,
Aleruuya! Ye Kabaka,
Ye Muwanguzi yekka.
Bangi nnyo abaatusooka
Okuyita mu kufa,
Bagulumiza Mukama
Atununudde fenna.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Aleruuya! Ye Kitaffe
Tetuli bamulekwa
Bulijjo abeera naffe
Fenna-abamukkiriza.
Bwe yatwalibwa mu ggulu
N'ekitiibwa mu kire,
Yatusuubiriza ddala
Okubeeranga naffe.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Atusembeza-atuyita,
Okusseekimu naye,
Atuliisa ffe-abanafu
Emmere-ey'omu ggulu
Alyoke atuwe-amaanyi
Aganaamalangawo
Enkwe zonna-ez'omulabe,
N'okukemebwa kwonna.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ka tutendereze Yesu
Eyajja mu nsi yaffe,
Eyayambala-omubiri
Ne yeetwalira-obuntu.
Ye Muwolereza waffe;
Ye Mununuzi yekka,
Ye Musuutwa, ye Mukama,
Ye Kabaka-ataggwaawo.
